title: StockSmart Field Service Note — Restock Cover for Frequently Visited Programs
content:
For the fill-to level of a new consigned bin under the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program that takes over an item the customer has had taken out of one of its VendPoint machines, the restock cover follows how often the program is actually visited.

**Rule.** The restock cover follows the program's visits: a program whose tier schedules 20 or more visits a month and that completed 18 or more scheduled or onsite daily visits in the latest month takes a restock cover of 0.5 week; a program whose tier schedules 8 to 19 visits a month and that completed 6 or more such visits in the latest month takes 1 week. Any other program's restock cover is not shortened under this note.

**The latest month.** A row's age in whole months is the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the row's day of the month; the latest month holds visits of age zero. Only completed visits of the scheduled and onsite daily kinds count; emergency visits do not.

### Truth table

| Visits the tier schedules a month | Scheduled or onsite daily visits completed in the latest month | Restock cover under this note |
|---|---|---|
| 20 or more | 18 or more | 0.5 week |
| 20 or more | 17 or fewer | not shortened |
| 8 to 19 | 6 or more | 1 week |
| 8 to 19 | 5 or fewer | not shortened |
| 7 or fewer | any number | not shortened |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- A tier scheduling 20 visits a month with exactly 18 completed in the latest month takes 0.5 week; with 17 it is not shortened.
- A tier scheduling exactly 8 visits a month with exactly 6 completed takes 1 week; a tier scheduling 19 with 6 completed also takes 1 week.
